owners.invariant: One personal management acknowledgement bound to exact engagement revision and complete service history.
owners.mustPreserve: Never reactivate a permanent independence commitment from reevaluation; acceptance binds exact service, draft, acknowledgement and ratified-rule proofs.

owners.declaredIdentity: Tenant EvidenceStreams key artifactId; capture registration stable source identity; inspection is single transition; download uses requestId in event but never retains/compares it; OCC uses hydrated stream position. owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / existing EvidenceStreams artifact key / ArtifactId, with immutable source identity and verified content binding. ArtifactId identifies registration; selected mutations use CommandId. Download grants use the separately adopted artifact-qualified receiving identity.
owners.invariant: Immutable content remains unavailable until clean inspection; malware alone can be released with attributed clean rescan; secret/invalid rejection is final.
owners.boundaryRationale: Inspection and quarantine release share availability decision. Download authorization needs an admission proof against that decision but every historical download need not extend artifact lifecycle stream.

owners.invariant: One exact artifact identity has one current reviewed classification, changed only at expected revision with attributed rationale.
owners.boundaryRationale: Current classification CAS must remain atomic; past classifications/history do not participate in that decision.

owners.declaredIdentity: Tenant / evidence-redactions / redactionId; preparation/approval IDs are context.RequestId and compare normalized intent before revision. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / evidence-redactions / RedactionId, with exact source artifact/content/version. Selected preparations, approvals and other mutations use CommandId.
owners.invariant: A redaction approval must target current exact original/derived preparation and be independent of its preparer unless exact scoped waiver proof authorizes self-approval.
owners.boundaryRationale: Preparation and approval need same-version admission gate; historical preparations/approvals can be read-side facts with selected-command retry lookup. Waiver is a separate owner and must enter as a value proof.

owners.mustPreserve: Exactly one terminal transition; require exact source/delivery proof as appropriate.

owners.declaredIdentity: UUIDv5 tenant + program/artifact/type/target/revision/period; exact retry matches all relationship facts/actor; one creation append. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
owners.selectedIdentity: Existing deterministic UUIDv5 of tenant + program/artifact/type/target/revision/period. Selected CommandId binds the exact immutable relationship and actor; the tuple algorithm is unchanged.
owners.invariant: One relationship identity immutably binds exact artifact content/revision, target revision and covered period with attributed sufficiency rationale.
owners.boundaryRationale: Relationship components must be bound together to distinguish conflicting assertions; source artifact and target lifecycles already remain elsewhere.

owners.declaredIdentity: Tenant / examinations / engagementId; baselineId and amendmentId supplied; original freeze and historical amendment retries compared by baselineId; Revise checks expected revision first. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / examinations / ExaminationId, with immutable ProgramId and exact baseline/amendment identities. ExaminationId identifies creation; selected mutations use CommandId and exact source-version bindings.
owners.invariant: Freeze locks Type I setup to exact approved boundary and complete source coverage; amendments preserve prior baseline and enumerate changed sources.
owners.boundaryRationale: Setup/freeze must commit one chosen baseline authorization atomically. Immutable baseline snapshots and history can be separately stored after preparing digest/content; current pointer/lock remains with engagement.

owners.declaredIdentity: Tenant / examination-signoffs / signOffId; first accepted content immutable; same initial content/actor/role/time retry; handler reuses retained SignedOffAt. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / examination-signoffs / SignOffId, with exact examination, package/snapshot, signer and role binding. SignOffId is the selected immutable creation identity.
owners.invariant: One final personal management decision binds exact package/assertion/letter/outcome and acknowledges exactly every unresolved material item.
owners.boundaryRationale: Known exceptions and acknowledgements form one accepted decision capsule; splitting them would permit signing a different set. Referenced source lifecycles stay independent.
